elements.text:
Stage	Flow	Feedback	Learning (Third Way)
Weeks 1-2
Understand	Map queues; choose pilot; agree WIP and owners	Baseline delivery metrics; collect Sales feedback	Trust charter; reserve 10% learning time
Weeks 3-5
Build	Create pipeline; small commits; automate repeatable tests	Return failed checks to owners; instrument staging	Pair Dev/Test; log experiments; review near misses
Weeks 6-8
Validate	Gated small pilot releases; rehearsed rollback	Monitor live behavior; review metrics/support weekly	Staging resilience drill; publish findings; revise WIP and gates
Weeks 9-12
Scale	Onboard other teams only when pilot gates pass	Compare metrics across teams with shared definitions	Peer onboarding; reuse runbooks; share monthly

elements.name: table-footnote
elements.text: Revision: culture and protected learning now start before tooling and rollout. Scale remains conditional.
